facts.claim: The City of Las Vegas states a combined transient lodging (room) tax of 13.38% for properties inside the Primary Gaming Corridor and 13% for properties outside it (schedule effective 1 March 2017, guide revised March 2026); the same totals apply to hotels of 75 or more rooms and to smaller ones.

sources.title: City of Las Vegas Business License Division: Transient Lodging Establishment Room Tax Instructions & Guidelines (rev. March 2026)

articles/where-to-stay-in-las-vegas.html: Inside the Primary Gaming Corridor, the zone around the Strip
The City of Las Vegas's room tax guidance, revised March 2026, sets two combined rates

facts.claim: The stadium share of the room tax is 0.88% inside the Primary Gaming Corridor and 0.5% outside it; the other components (LVCVA 6.12%, Nevada Department of Taxation 0.38%, City 1%, Clark County transportation 1% and education 1%, State 3%, for hotels of 75 or more rooms) are the same in both, giving 13.38% versus 13%.

sources.title: City of Las Vegas Business License Division: Transient Lodging Establishment Room Tax Instructions & Guidelines (rev. March 2026)

facts.claim: The FTC's Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees (16 CFR Part 464), effective 12 May 2025, covers short-term lodging including hotels; its FAQ uses a mandatory resort fee as an example that must be included in the total price, displayed more prominently than other pricing information, while taxes and other government charges may be excluded from the upfront total.
